label: Nango
description: Manage integrations, connections, synced records, syncs and actions

operations.name: list_integrations
operations.description: List the integrations configured in this Nango environment.

operations.name: get_integration
operations.description: Read integration details, without requesting credentials or webhook secrets.

operations.name: create_integration
operations.description: Create an integration without developer-app credentials; configure those in Nango.

operations.name: update_integration
operations.description: Update the display name and webhook forwarding preference.

operations.name: delete_integration
operations.description: Delete the selected integration from Nango.

operations.name: list_functions
operations.description: List one page of integration functions. Requires environment:functions:list.

operations.name: list_connections
operations.description: List one page of connections, without connection credentials.

operations.name: get_connection
operations.description: Read connection details. Credentials returned by Nango are removed from output.

operations.name: update_connection
operations.description: Update connection tags; keys are normalized to lowercase by Nango.

operations.name: delete_connection
operations.description: Delete the connection within the selected integration.

operations.name: set_connection_metadata
operations.description: Replace metadata on a single connection.

operations.name: update_connection_metadata
operations.description: Merge supplied metadata fields into a single connection's metadata.

operations.name: get_records
operations.description: Fetch one page of synced records. Continue with next_cursor until null.

operations.name: trigger_sync
operations.description: Trigger syncs for one connection. The acknowledgement does not prove completion.

operations.name: start_sync
operations.description: Start scheduled syncs for one connection.

operations.name: pause_sync
operations.description: Pause scheduled syncs for one connection.

operations.name: get_sync_status
operations.description: Read sync status for one connection.

operations.name: trigger_action
operations.description: Trigger an action once; async acknowledgements return an ID for polling.

operations.name: get_action_result
operations.description: Read an asynchronous action result by its ID. A 404 can mean it is still running.
